defects.rootCause: The public Sheet URL was unbounded, so later draft rows entered the release-content candidate set after the 616-row corpus had already been reviewed and deployed.
defects.fix: Pin the published source request to A1:U617, preserving the header plus the existing reviewed 616 records without altering legal content.

observationsNotClassifiedAsDefects.observation: One tooltip visibility read occurred before its 160 ms transition had settled.
observationsNotClassifiedAsDefects.evidence: Five subsequent trials using a 350 ms settled read passed open and Escape dismissal 5/5.

observationsNotClassifiedAsDefects.observation: Local signed-out protected routes correctly made the header inert while the authentication dialog was open.
observationsNotClassifiedAsDefects.evidence: Tooltip testing was repeated on the public root route, where open and reload recovery passed 5/5.
